description: Verify Σ_λ 1/d_λ = 5/2 at n=3 and explore whether it arises from a natural Kerov walk.  Finds: the uniform-step and Plancherel walks give different distributions; Σ 1/d_λ is a Plancherel-dual quantity equal to Σ h(λ)/n! where h(λ) is the hook-length product.  No natural walk interpretation found.
